name: Locker
summary: Locker is a utility EA for MetaTrader 5 that manages trade locking (hedging) functionality, allowing traders to lock floating profits or losses by opening opposite positions. It serves as a position management tool rather than an autonomous trading strategy, providing semi-automated control over existing trades through lock/unlock operations.
summary_zh: Locker是一个MetaTrader 5工具型EA，主要用于管理交易锁定（对冲）功能，允许交易者通过开立反向仓位来锁定浮动盈利或亏损。它是一个仓位管理工具而非自主交易策略，通过锁定/解锁操作提供对现有持仓的半自动控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非自主交易策略，而是一个仓位锁定管理工具。其核心概念是通过开立与现有持仓方向相反的同等手数仓位来实现锁定，从而冻结当前的浮动盈亏。入场条件基于用户手动触发或设定的条件触发锁定操作，而非基于技术指标信号。出场条件同样由用户控制，通过解锁操作平掉反向仓位以恢复原始敞口。仓位管理方面，锁定仓位的手数与原始仓位匹配，确保完全对冲。资金管理方面，该EA不涉及独立的资金管理逻辑，因为它不主动开仓交易，仅管理现有仓位。整体而言，该工具适用于有经验的交易者在波动市场中保护利润或限制亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an autonomous trading strategy but rather a position locking management utility. Its core concept involves opening opposite positions of equal lot size to existing holdings, thereby freezing current floating profit or loss. Entry conditions are based on user manual triggers or preset conditions for the locking operation, not on technical indicator signals. Exit conditions are similarly user-controlled, executing unlock operations to close opposite positions and restore the original exposure. In terms of position sizing, the lock position's lot size matches the original position to ensure a complete hedge. Regarding money management, the EA does not implement independent money management logic since it does not proactively open new trades but only manages existing positions. Overall, this tool is suitable for experienced traders looking to protect profits or limit losses in volatile markets.

parameters.name: LockType
parameters.description: 锁定类型：0=完全锁定，1=部分锁定
parameters.description_en: Lock type: 0 = full lock, 1 = partial lock

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔法编号，用于识别本EA管理的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to identify its own orders

parameters.name: LockPercent
parameters.description: 锁定百分比，100为完全锁定，可设置部分锁定比例
parameters.description_en: Lock percentage, 100 = full lock, adjustable for partial

parameters.name: AutoLock
parameters.description: 是否启用自动锁定功能

parameters.name: LockProfit
parameters.description: 达到指定盈利时自动锁定的金额阈值

parameters.name: UnlockOnSignal
parameters.description: 是否在信号触发时自动解锁

pros: 提供灵活的仓位锁定功能，帮助交易者在不确定市场中保护已有利润
支持手动和自动两种锁定模式，适应不同交易风格和需求
完全对冲机制可有效冻结浮动盈亏，减少情绪化交易决策
操作简单直观，适合各类经验水平的交易者使用
pros_en: Provides flexible position locking functionality to help traders protect existing profits in uncertain markets
Supports both manual and automatic locking modes, adapting to different trading styles and needs
Complete hedging mechanism effectively freezes floating P&L, reducing emotionally-driven trading decisions
Simple and intuitive operation, suitable for traders of all experience levels
cons: 锁定后占用双倍保证金，可能影响账户可用资金和交易能力
频繁锁定解锁可能增加交易成本（点差和佣金）
不具备自主交易能力，依赖用户判断和操作，对新手不够友好
在极端行情下，锁定可能因滑点或流动性不足而无法精确执行
cons_en: Locking occupies double margin, potentially affecting account available funds and trading capacity
Frequent locking and unlocking may increase trading costs (spreads and commissions)
Lacks autonomous trading capability, relying on user judgment and operation, not beginner-friendly
In extreme market conditions, locking may not execute precisely due to slippage or insufficient liquidity
improvements: 增加可视化面板显示当前锁定状态和盈亏信息，提升用户体验
增加追踪止损与锁定联动的复合保护机制，在趋势行情中更灵活
增加多品种批量锁定功能，提升对多品种组合交易的管理效率
improvements_en: Add a visual panel displaying current lock status and P&L information to improve user experience
Integrate a compound protection mechanism linking trailing stops with locking for more flexibility in trending markets
Add multi-symbol batch locking functionality to improve management efficiency for multi-instrument portfolio trading

risk_points: 锁定操作本身不产生方向性风险，但双倍持仓占用更多保证金
自动锁定若参数设置不当可能在不利时点触发锁定
risk_points_en: Locking itself does not create directional risk, but double positions occupy more margin
Auto-locking may trigger at unfavorable points if parameters are improperly set

summary_en: Locker is a utility EA for MetaTrader 5 that manages trade locking (hedging) functionality, allowing traders to lock floating profits or losses by opening opposite positions. It serves as a position management tool rather than an autonomous trading strategy, providing semi-automated control over existing trades through lock/unlock operations.
